results.note: No page states a church admission price. Visit Lisboa's page covers only the neighbouring Museu de Lisboa – Santo António and gives no price. Time Out lists the museum at 3€ or 4€ (conflicting), which is a different venue.

Sources conflict and none was verified. Resellers and blogs give €2.50, €3.50, €4.50 and €5. The Visit Lisboa page I could read shows no amount, only free with the Lisboa Card. The Visit Lisboa shop page returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited), so I couldn't read it.
No page found that states an admission price, or says entry is free.

The only price source is a Time Out Lisboa news article, which is neither an official nor a ticketing/government page. It says a single €4 ticket covers the church, bell towers, walkway and upper choir. A visitor guide also says €4 for the terrace, with the church itself free to look inside. I did not find an official parish or Patriarchate page confirming this.
